finding.shortLabel: Shared matching-criteria profile: tailor, wife Mary, five named children, birth c.1602–1610, gone from England by 1641
finding.statement: Any English candidate for the Braintree emigrant must satisfy one shared profile drawn from his colonial baseline: a tailor by trade; married to a wife named Mary who bore children Sarah, Mary, Richard, John, and Peter; born in England within a c.1602–1610 window read off his own 1652/3 age deposition; and gone from the English record by the time he first appears in Massachusetts in June 1641. A settled Puritan household is a soft fifth criterion. This whole profile, not a bare surname match, is the shared test applied to every alternative candidate.
